critic.rewrite_notes: Very strong. 'Check your phone with the screen off' and 'Stare at the window like it's news' are the standout lines. Only small note: item 5 slightly overlaps the payoff; could instead be 'Get off at the wrong stop to escape'.
critic.sendability_who: A 20-30 year old commuter who'd send it to the one friend they text on the bus — 'literally me this morning, number 5' — usually after an awkward window-seat encounter.

critic.rewrite_notes: Strong list: 'where'd you go text' and 'story on mute' are lived-in. Hook is overloaded ('apologising for it: 8 habits') — trim to 'You left the party at 9pm. Now you're apologising for it.' Item 6 is the weakest ('search how to exit') — swap for a concrete object beat. Payoff sets dignity well.
critic.sendability_who: A 20-28 year old who leaves parties at 9pm and spends the bus home drafting apologies they never send — 'number 3 lives in my notes app' to the one friend who leaves with them.

critic.sendability_who: A 20-30 year old who's spent whole parties in a coat, waiting for an exit — the friend who'd send it with 'the coat thing, you know the coat thing' or just 'me'.
